value.rationale: Canonical-line root rigidity is a geometric property known to fail for some Calabi–Yau manifolds. Establishing it simultaneously for all ambient-induced positive polarizations, not just a single canonical class, throughout four natural Picard-rank-two blowup families is a substantive structural answer; the exact strict Chern inequality is independently interpretable and useful for geometry of polarized fourfolds.
